statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, Summable (fun j => ‖f j‖) → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ((∑' j, ‖f j‖)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)
proof:
intro f g hf hg
let y : ℤ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun j => ⟨(fun k => g (k-j)), (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 _).1.mp (yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_T013 g j hg).1⟩
have hy : ∀ j, ‖y j‖ = KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by
 intro j
 exact ((yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 _).2 _).symm.trans (yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_T013 g j hg).2
let v : ℤ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun j => f j • y j
have hvn : ∀ j, ‖v j‖ = ‖f j‖*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by intro j; dsimp [v]; rw [norm_smul, hy]
have hv : Summable (fun j => ‖v j‖) := by simpa only [hvn] using hf.mul_right (KdVPlan.hn 0 g)
let w : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ∑' j, v j
have hw : KdVPlan.mul f g = (fun k => w k) := by
 funext k
 have H := (lp.evalCLM ℂ (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 k).map_tsum (Summable.of_norm hv)
 exact H.symm
have hwMem : KdVPlan.MemH 0 (fun k => w k) := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 _).1.mpr w.prop
refine ⟨hw ▸ hwMem, ?_⟩
calc
 KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) = ‖w‖ := (congrArg (KdVPlan.hn 0) hw).trans ((yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 _).2 w.prop)
 _ ≤ ∑' j, ‖v j‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hv
 _ = (∑' j, ‖f j‖)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by simp only [hvn, tsum_mul_right]
